picks.headline: Runway is now in DaVinci Resolve | Runway
picks.excerpt: Get started: Access the world's best models directly inside your timeline to generate, edit and upscale without leaving your project. Get started at the link in bio.
picks.rationale: Runway's models now run inside the Resolve timeline for generating, editing and upscaling. Editors can use generative video without leaving their NLE, starting today.

picks.headline: YouTube is building AI creator tools that do almost everything for them
picks.excerpt: The future of creating on YouTube looks like a lot of AI
picks.rationale: Made on YouTube brings AI thumbnails, tests and catalog tools to the largest video platform. Every video creator's publishing workflow will change as a result.

picks.headline: This Is Where Filmmaking Is Headed Next (Full Tutorial)
picks.excerpt: In this video, we tested a hybrid filmmaking workflow that combines live-action footage with AI to transform simple greybox shots into entirely new environments. Check out the full written breakdown and prompts here: Check out our courses: And our latest Micro-drama course: Get AI Film News Sent to
picks.rationale: A hands-on hybrid workflow that turns greybox live-action shots into finished environments with AI, with prompts included. Small crews can copy the method directly.

picks.headline: 'Adolescence' Scribe Jack Thorne Warns: Writers Using AI To "Cheat"
picks.excerpt: 'Adolescence' writer Jack Thorne has warned that his colleagues are using AI to "cheat." He added that those caught should be punished.
picks.rationale: A leading screenwriter says colleagues are secretly using AI and should be punished when caught. It is a signal of where writers'-room norms and disclosure expectations are heading.

picks.headline: Anyone can make stunning HD videos with Gemini Omni in Google Vids
picks.excerpt: Get high-quality video production right from your browser. Anyone with a Google account can create videos for free in Google Vids.
picks.rationale: Google puts its Gemini Omni video model in a free browser tool for anyone with a Google account. That lowers the cost of HD generative video to zero for previz and pitch material.
